backed.title: Built on real *yoga education*
paragraphs: YogSetu is an initiative by ==YogKulam==, India's Yoga Career Launch Platform.
Open to ==every qualified teacher== — trained with YogKulam or elsewhere.

founder.quote:
Good yoga teachers struggle to reach the people who need them. Students struggle to know ==whom to trust==.

YogSetu is our bridge — so the right teacher and the right seeker can ==find each other==.
